svg.title: The empires of ancient Ghana, Mali and Songhai
svg.desc: Approximate core areas of three great Western Sudanese empires along the upper and middle Niger: ancient Ghana (about 300 to 1076, in the Sahel north of the Senegal and Niger, capital Kumbi Saleh), Mali (about 1235 to 1600, centred on the upper Niger, capital Niani), and Songhai (about 1464 to 1591, along the Niger bend, capital Gao). Trading cities included Walata, Timbuktu and Djenné. Areas are approximate.
